description: Defines interfaces and notifiers for the PDCP (Packet Data Convergence Protocol) entity in a wireless communication stack, including classes for transmitting side notifications, interfaces, control, and related mechanisms.

classes.name: pdcp_tx_lower_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying the lower layers about new PDUs and discard commands in the PDCP transmit path.

classes.name: pdcp_tx_lower_interface
classes.description: Interface for informing the PDCP transmit entity about buffer sizes, transmission, delivery, retransmission, and retransmission delivery notifications.

classes.name: pdcp_tx_upper_data_interface
classes.description: Interface for upper layers to pass SDUs into the PDCP transmit entity.

classes.name: pdcp_tx_upper_control_interface
classes.description: Interface for configuring security, triggering recovery, re-establishment, buffering, and flow control in the PDCP transmit entity.

classes.name: pdcp_tx_upper_control_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying upper layers about protocol failures, max count reached, and resume requirements.
